name: What are common challenges during a garage conversion?

mainEntity.name: What are common challenges during a garage conversion?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common challenges during a garage conversion include addressing inadequate insulation, ensuring proper heating and cooling for the new space, navigating complex permitting requirements, and integrating new plumbing or electrical systems with existing ones. Drainage and flooring unevenness can also be issues if not properly addressed. A skilled contractor can anticipate and mitigate these challenges through thorough planning and execution.
acceptedAnswer.description: Challenges include insulation, HVAC, permitting, utility integration, and flooring. A skilled contractor can help address these.
